JSONB ?, ?&, ?| and @? have key-exists, all-key, any-key and JSONPath-exists semantics; @> and <@ represent reversed typed containment across array, ACL, JSONB, ranges and geometry.
Geometry ?# box and full-text @@@ and point >^ have PostgreSQL catalog deprecated descriptions but remain native compatibility, not verified DIC-obsolete objects.

Full SQL wrappers: path_contain_pt(path,point) RETURNS on_ppath($2,$1); textanycat(text,anynonarray) and anytextcat(anynonarray,text) are STABLE STRICT and explicitly cast polymorphic operand to pg_catalog.text before concatenation. No broken internal wrapper.
Prefix ^@, regex ~ / ~*, pattern ~<~ etc, LIKE ~~ / ~~*, JSONB vs tsvector ||, geometric ~=, unary |/ and ||/ are different typed behavior. No confirmed business defect or safe deletion.
All present reciprocal commutator/negator links validate; operator-family consumers exist. Native implementation binaries remain UNVERIFIED; entire provider baseline not complete.
